settings.subtitles.needsAccount: This site needs your account: fill in {fields}.
settings.subtitles.title: Subtitles
settings.subtitles.defaultLangsDesc: For titles without their own. Empty means no subtitles.
settings.subtitles.hiText: Normal also counts a hearing-impaired subtitle as there; Hearing-impaired only waits for one with sound descriptions; Either takes any.
settings.subtitles.forcedText: means only the lines for foreign speech or signs.
settings.subtitles.passHint: Auto-saved at this score or higher
settings.subtitles.pass1: Every subtitle a site offers gets a match score from 0 to 100: points for the right name, year, season and episode, the same release group, source, resolution and codec as your file, the hearing-impaired and forced choice you asked for, a trusted uploader and a matching frame rate. A subtitle for another title, year or episode scores 0.
settings.subtitles.pass2: A search saves a subtitle on its own only when it scores the Pass mark or more. 90 for episodes means the show, year, season and episode must match; 70 for movies means the name, year and some of the release details must. Lower marks take looser matches (more often out of sync); higher marks wait for a closer one. Choosing a subtitle by hand on a movie or show page may take any score.
settings.subtitles.sitesNote: Lowest priority number first. Failing sites rest, then retry.
settings.subtitles.name: Name
settings.subtitles.accountNote: This site needs your own account with it. The details are kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.subtitles.accountKeep: Leave them empty to keep the stored ones.
settings.subtitles.perDay: Downloads a day (0 for no limit)
settings.subtitles.noneText: Add one to find missing subtitles.
settings.subtitles.whenToLookDesc: New files search at once, then on a timer
settings.subtitles.lastDays: For subtitles saved in the last (days)
settings.subtitles.countInsideHint: Skips languages already in the file
settings.subtitles.noPictureHint: Many players can't show disc subtitles
settings.subtitles.hiSuffixHint: File ending players read as SDH
settings.subtitles.syncNote: A subtitle out of time is fixed by hand on its movie or episode: shift every line, or change the frame rate. HolyArrs does not listen to the sound to line subtitles up.
